purpose: one Ridge return predictor with a predeclared clipped linear allocation rule
features: 94 official base columns plus 3 one-record-lagged training fields
preprocessing: training-only median imputation with empty columns kept, standardized values, all-column missing indicators

mapping.rule: clip(1 + 0.25 * forecast / rms_oof, 0, 2); neutral if rms_oof below floor
mapping.wire_precision: float32 allocations, matching official Python-float scalar transport

api_replay: 16 rows from the second development window; no reserved or mock-test rows
